title: Chen Nian's Entrustment
next_chapter_hook: Chen Nian whispered softly: "Brother, the death prophecy at chapter 700... I don't believe it."

text.content: The voice pierced his soul like an ice awl, and Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The words from the depths of the dimensional rift carried an suffocating pressure with every syllable—that was an aura beyond the mortal realm, the gaze of a chess player looking down at his pieces. He stood on the platform where the new order was proclaimed, the cheers deafening around him, yet he alone felt that bone-piercing chill. However, in the next instant, his gaze swept past the crowd and landed on the frail figure on the stretcher—Chen Nian's robes were soaked with blood, yet a faint smile still lingered on her pale face. The Heavenly Dao chess player, the fate of being a piece—none of it mattered now. He gripped the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve and strode toward that figure, his pace far more urgent than when he had just declared his decree.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao blocked Chen Ji's path, her usually cold and proud eyes now filled with self-blame and anxiety: "It was my carelessness. The Demonic Path remnant's ambush... If she hadn't blocked that fatal strike for me, the one lying here would be me." She paused, her voice dropping several tones, "Her injuries are extremely severe, her meridians completely severed, but I examined her—there's something strange happening with her bloodline. It's疯狂 self-repairing." Su Qingyao lifted her gaze to meet Chen Ji's, rarely showing a puzzled expression, "Chen Ji, who exactly is she? How many secrets is your Chen family hiding that I don't know about?"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer. He gently pushed Su Qingyao aside and bent down to lift Chen Nian from the stretcher into his arms. The girl was impossibly light, as if she might dissipate with the wind at any moment. Her body temperature was ice cold, her breathing faint, only her tightly furrowed brow revealing that even in her unconscious state, she was still enduring excruciating pain. Chen Ji felt his heart being gripped by an invisible hand—he had been scheming across the world, his plans flawless for so many years, yet this was the first time he understood what it meant to 'lose control'. He carried her swiftly toward the inner hall, his voice commanding the servants surprisingly calm, only his trembling fingertips betraying the turmoil within.

dialogue.content: On the evening of the third day, Chen Nian finally awakened. The first words from her lips were: "Brother, you've gotten thinner." Chen Ji sat beside the couch, his face bearing three days without sleep and a faint shadow of stubble, yet a trace of elusive relief flickered in his eyes. Chen Nian struggled to pull out an ancient yellowed silk scroll from under her pillow and pressed it into her brother's hands: "This is... what I obtained from the remnant soul of a Chen family ancestor while imprisoned in the Holy Sect." Her voice was weak yet firm, "They said... it's for you. After you read this, you'll understand everything about the Chen family."

text.content: The silk scroll slowly unfurled under the candlelight. Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently—the characters on it were completely unfamiliar to him, yet he could understand every single word perfectly. "Chen bloodline, guarding through generations. The fourth possibility, seed deeply hidden. Heavenly fate can be defied, but the time has not yet come... If one day the chess player awakens, wishing to break through heavenly secrets— At the scroll's end was a blurred diagram, showing a figure holding a Tianji Record, standing outside the chessboard, overlooking the entire world. Chen Ji's breathing grew rapid. He lifted his head to look at Chen Nian, only to see the girl with tears in her eyes yet smiling: "Brother, our Chen family... was never any废物 bloodline. We are rebels against heavenly fate, guardians of the fourth possibility."

Chen Ji was silent for a long while. The words on the scroll were like a key, unlocking doubts he had sealed in his heart for many years—why would the Tianji Record choose him, this 'waste'? Why did the Chen family decline through generations, labeled as waste yet never truly having their bloodline severed? Why would Chen Nian's existence interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight? Everything had an explanation now. He was a piece in heaven's game, but the Chen family—existed to shatter the chessboard. Night wind poured through the window cracks, causing the candle flame to flicker unsteadily. Chen Nian struggled to sit up but was gently pressed back onto her shoulder by her brother. She looked at Chen Ji, her eyes holding no resentment, only heartache: "Brother, scheming across the world all these years... are you tired?"

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's question struck directly at his heart. Chen Ji had been scheming across the world for years, wearing the mask of a 'waste' in the martial world, yet no one had ever asked him if he was tired. At this moment, the masks of chess player and piece could seemingly be set aside—the one before him was blood-related family.

choices.text: Laying Down Masks, Speaking Heart to Heart
choices.description: For the first time admitting his exhaustion and loneliness to anyone, letting Chen Nian see the Chen Ji no one else knew.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji froze for a moment, then a bitter smile appeared at the corner of his mouth: "Tired?" He gently repeated this word, as if savoring an unfamiliar taste. "Scheming across the world, plans flawless—sounds very impressive. But all these years, I haven't even had one person I could speak真心话 with." His gaze fell on Chen Nian's face, "Until you returned." Chen Nian's eyes instantly turned red.

choices.text: Habitually Deflecting, Asking Chen Nian Instead
choices.description: Using jokes to lighten the heavy atmosphere, probing Chen Nian's true thoughts, maintaining the distance of a chess player.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the Chance for Genuine Connection
choices.visible_reward: Learning More of Chen Nian's Thoughts
choices.risk_hint: Might Make Chen Nian Feel Distant

dialogue.content: Chen Ji laughed lightly, that smile carrying habitual distance: "Tired? I'm used to it. As for you, being captured by the Holy Sect for so long, you suffered a lot, didn't you?" Chen Nian watched him quietly, then suddenly said: "Brother, you're always like this. You're clearly carrying everyone in your heart, yet you insist on pretending you don't care about anything." Chen Ji's smile froze on his face.

text.content: Chen Nian struggled to sit up. Chen Ji had intended to stop her but withdrew his hand under her stubborn gaze. A shrewd smile, strikingly similar to his own, appeared on the girl's pale face: "Brother, you think I don't know? All these years you've been scheming across the world, treating everyone as a piece on the board—Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even that old fox Ling Yuan." Her voice was weak yet clear, "But you overlooked one thing." Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: "Oh?" Chen Nian extended her pinky, gently hooking it with her brother's finger: "I'm your family, not your piece. A family with a废物persona can still have people who stick up for their own."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's Adam's apple bobbed slightly. He looked at this face that was five-tenths similar to his own, suddenly realizing the little girl from his memories had grown far too much. Chen Nian continued, her tone gentle yet firm: "That day when I blocked that sword for Sister Su, it wasn't for any grand strategy, wasn't any part of a plan—it was simply because I didn't want you to lose family again." Her eyes reddened, "When Father and Mother died, you were only twelve, carrying everything alone. All those years I was taken by the Holy Sect, I kept thinking... how lonely Brother must have been." Chen Ji's eyes actually grew hot. He turned his face away, his voice somewhat hoarse: "Silly girl..."

choice.prompt: The reunion of blood-related family caused cracks to appear in the ice wall Chen Ji had built around his heart for years. Chen Nian said she was family, not a piece—then was he willing to let her truly enter his world?

choices.description: Telling Chen Nian the complete truth about the Tianji Record, including the existence of the chapter 700 death prophecy.
choices.visible_reward: No More Barriers Between Brother and Sister
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian Might Take Risks to Find a Solution

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a long time before finally speaking: "Nian'er, there's something I need to tell you." He placed the Tianji Record Fragment into Chen Nian's hands, "This records my fate—there will be a deadly trap at chapter 700." Chen Nian gripped the silk scroll tightly, light of determination flashing in her eyes: "Then we'll break it. Brother, the Chen family has guarded the fourth possibility for generations—I refuse to believe... we can't break a death prophecy."

choices.memory_label: 陈念已成为陈机最亲密的家人，她知晓了天机录的秘密，成为他对抗命运的同行者

choices.description: Admitting he's in a difficult situation but concealing the specific content of the chapter 700 death prophecy, protecting her from the shock.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian Might Sense the Deception and Feel Hurt

dialogue.content: Chen Ji spoke casually about the Tianji Record, glossing over the death prophecy portion. Chen Nian watched him quietly, then suddenly said: "Brother, you're lying to me again." Chen Ji froze. The girl smiled bitterly: "You taught me since I was little, don't tell lies, those who lie will eventually be devoured by their own lies. But you?" Chen Ji had no response.

text.content: It was deep into the night. Chen Ji ordered someone to bring a pot of coarse wine, and the brother and sister sat facing each other across the table. Moonlight streamed through the window lattice, casting mottled shadows on the ground. Chen Nian cradled a rough pottery wine bowl, her face bearing a tipsy flush: "Brother, I remember when we were little, you took me to steal peaches from our neighbor's backyard mountain, and we were chased for three streets..." Chen Ji nearly choked on his wine: "How do you still remember that nonsense!" Chen Nian giggled, her laughter clear as silver bells, completely different from the heavily injured girl of the daytime. After several rounds of drinks, tears welled at the corners of her eyes: "Brother, all these years I've had many nightmares, dreaming of you walking alone through darkness, no matter how I called you, you never turned around..." Chen Ji's hand stopped.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji set down the wine bowl, his voice low: "Nian'er, I had a dream too." His gaze turned toward the night sky outside the window, as if looking at some distant scene, "I dreamed I stood in the center of a chessboard, surrounded by black pieces everywhere. I thought I was the chess player, only to discover... I was merely a piece on another board." Chen Nian listened quietly. Chen Ji turned to look at her, his eyes rarely showing a hint of confusion: "You say I can break heavenly fate, but if even the Tianji Record itself is someone else's scheme—what do I have to rely on?" Chen Nian was silent for a moment, then suddenly reached out and covered Chen Ji's hand with her own. Her palm was warm and firm: "Brother, you still have me. In this world, there are things beyond the chessboard."

text.content: At that very moment, something strange happened. The scars on Chen Nian's hand suddenly glowed with a faint golden light, those ferocious-looking wounds seeming to come alive, spreading along her blood vessels throughout her entire body, finally converging into an ancient rune at her heart. At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms also trembled slightly, emanating a gentle aura that responded in harmony. Chen Nian clutched her chest, a flash of astonishment crossing her face: "Brother, this is..." Chen Ji's pupils narrowed slightly as he said solemnly: "Blood Pulse Resonance." He grasped Chen Nian's wrist, feeling that strange energy flowing—this was the power left by the Chen family's ancestors, passing down through their brother and sister's bloodline.

choice.prompt: The phenomenon caused by the Blood Pulse Resonance granted Chen Nian the Chen family's ancestral ability. Her scars were healing, but simultaneously, she could vaguely 'see' some blurry images—those were the threads of fate.

choices.text: Letting Chen Nian Choose for Herself Whether to Inherit
choices.description: This ability may have a price, and Chen Ji wants to respect his sister's wishes, letting her decide whether to accept this inheritance.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji released Chen Nian's wrist and said softly: "Nian'er, this is the Chen family's inheritance, and ultimately you must decide for yourself." Chen Nian said without hesitation: "I accept." Her gaze was firm, "Since the Chen family has guarded the fourth possibility for generations, then I will walk this path... for our ancestors, for Brother." The golden light on her grew increasingly brilliant, and when the light faded, the rune at her heart had taken shape—it was the Eye of Fate Observation.

choices.memory_label: 陈念觉醒了陈家祖传的命运观测能力，成为陈机最重要的战略支援

choices.text: Stopping the Inheritance, Believing the Cost Too High
choices.description: Chen Ji fears this ability will harm Chen Nian, trying to block the Blood Pulse Resonance, unwilling to let his sister face danger.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji grabbed Chen Nian's wrist violently, attempting to block the energy flow: "No! This inheritance must have a price, I can't let you—" Chen Nian gripped his hand in return, cutting him off: "Brother, you're always like this. Trying to carry everything alone, not wanting to burden anyone." She smiled, that smile holding tears and light together, "But I am a member of the Chen family. Guarding the fourth possibility is our shared responsibility, not yours alone." The golden light broke through Chen Ji's block and surged into Chen Nian's body.

text.content: After the golden light faded, Chen Nian slowly opened her eyes. Deep within her eyes, there was now a layer of pale golden light—the unique mark of a Fate Observer. She lowered her head to look at her own hands, her voice trembling slightly: "Brother, I can see now..." Chen Ji asked nervously: "See what?" Chen Nian lifted her head, her gaze seeming to penetrate through layers of void, as if looking at some distant place: "I see you standing in chaos, surrounded by many... threads. Some are golden, some are black. The golden ones connect to me, to Sister Su, to Ye Qing..." She paused, her voice dropping, "But there's one black thread, connected to your life vein, slowly tightening." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

The moonlight remained cold and clear, yet Chen Ji felt a chill rise from his spine. He looked at this girl who had just awakened her abilities, his heart filled with myriad emotions—concern, heartache, and an indescribable complexity. Chen Nian withdrew her gaze and offered him a bright smile: "Brother, don't worry. That black thread is still very thin, we have time." She gripped Chen Ji's hand tightly, "And now, I can help you too. Not as a piece—as a sister, as a comrade-in-arms." Chen Ji's Adam's apple bobbed, and in the end, he could only gently pat her head: "Silly girl..." But his eyes were already slightly reddened.

Night wind rose outside the window, dispersing the wine's influence. Chen Nian leaned against the couch, a satisfied smile on her face, as if everything that had just transpired had exhausted her energy, yet granted her unprecedented peace. Chen Ji watched her quietly, suddenly realizing it had been a long time since he had gazed so peacefully at another person. How many years? From the night his parents were brutally murdered, he had sealed himself within the chess game, never again letting anyone truly enter his heart. But this girl before him, with her stubbornness, her sacrifice, her trust, had pried open that tightly shut door. He gently tucked the blanket around Chen Nian and said softly: "Sleep. Starting tomorrow, Brother will teach you to play chess." Chen Nian's eyes closed, yet the corners of her mouth curved up: "Brother, are you going to teach me chess, or scheming across the world?" Chen Ji froze, then laughed softly: "Both."

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, the smile at the corners of Chen Nian's lips deepened. Eyes still closed, her voice gradually faded yet remained clear: "Brother, let me tell you a secret."
